entities.name: Baas
entities.description: A one-armed ogre shaman and tattoo artist of the Ghor clan of the Gruul.

entities.name: Ghor clan
entities.description: A clan of the Gruul to which Baas belongs.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Baas wreaks havoc on infrastructure.

entities.name: Arrus
entities.description: A viashino who meets Baas in her clan's camp and travels with her.

entities.name: Govan Radley
entities.description: Baas's relative, who caused the Tin Street Massacre.

entities.name: Daeska Solvar
entities.description: Baas's cyclops husband, who was unfaithful to her.

entities.name: Ossett Weslyn
entities.description: A figure who arranged Baas's release to learn of a spy in the Boros Legion.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A Ravnican guild with a spy within it.

entities.name: Tin Street Massacre
entities.description: An infamous incident attributed to Govan Radley.

entities.name: Selesnya
entities.description: A Ravnican guild with a secret project of accelerated growth magic.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: A region of Ravnica separated from Selesnyan territory by Selesnya's planned barrier.

events.summary: Baas drops the Radley name after the Tin Street Massacre, takes her husband's name, then leaves him and becomes only Baas.
events.quote: she left him and dropped his name too, becoming only "Baas".

events.summary: Ossett Weslyn arranges Baas's release to gain information about a spy within the Boros Legion.
events.quote: Ossett arranged for Baas' release to gain crucial information about a spy within the Boros Legion.

events.summary: Arrus meets Baas in her clan's camp; a tense meeting leads to a scuffle over ink.
events.quote: Their initial meeting was tense, leading to a scuffle over ink

events.summary: Arrus and Baas journey into Selesnyan territory for ingredients for her healing ink.
events.quote: They ventured into Selesnyan territory in search of ingredients for Baas's special ink

events.summary: Arrus discovers Selesnya's secret project to build a barrier between the Rubblebelt and Selesnyan territory, fueling his resolve to challenge his clan's leadership.

relations.quote: part of the Ghor clan of Gruul

relations.note: Former husband; she left him after learning of his infidelity.
relations.quote: using the name of her cyclops husband, Daeska Solvar
done by her relative, Govan Radley
